title: A small-tripling ball in a finitely generated group uniformly bounds later scales with new defining relations
author: Philip Easo and Tom Hutchcroft
difficulty_reason: The proof converts multiplicative lattices in nilpotent Lie groups into additive bracket-closed lattices with controlled indices, using rational BCH and Zassenhaus expansions. A geometry-of-numbers argument bounds strict subgroup changes along convex explorations, then Carnot scaling and free nilpotent covers transfer this to word balls. A quantitative virtually nilpotent quotient and finite-kernel lifting finally yield the uniform bound on new relation scales.
